text_block_list.text:
While organizing training equipment, I 
heard lively voices from the gym. Right, 
the students must be on lunch break now.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you won't hit me, not a chance. Your 
ball speed is dropping, you know.

Inside the gymnasium, No Reason was having 
a blast playing dodgeball with her 
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Come on, hit already... Hit it—!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I saw that coming... from a mile away!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Naive, far too naive. Today, dodging or 
taking a blow is entirely at my whim.

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Nice going, No Reason-san!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You're so reliable! Seal the deal on the 
next one, No Reason!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fwahahaha! Isn't that right, isn't that 
right?! Everyone, leave it all to me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Having the spotlight naturally roll right 
to me like this is just part of my 
destiny! Nya-ha-ha-ha!

Two people left on each side, with barely 
any time on the clock. If one more falls, 
the match is basically decided. Which 
means—
choice_data_list: (What decides the game... is pure speed!)

(What decides the game... is the weight 
behind the ball!)

text_block_list.text:
The opponent has no path to victory unless 
they catch the ball. In that case, the 
straightforward approach would be to 
challenge them purely with pitch speed.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fwahahaha! Behold my secret pitch! If 
thine eyes can track it, just try and 
catch it! This is my――

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gale-force swift God of Wind cannon, 
fireee!

The vigorously thrown ball soared far 
above the head of the opposing 
Umamusume... It bounced cleanly off the 
basketball hoop and—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oof!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: A self-destruct right here?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I-It hurffs... Nnnrgh... Th-This isn't... 
This isn't how it was supposed to go~!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You really are blessed with luck 
when it comes to stuff like this~.

The gym erupted in laughter, and in a way, 
No Reason totally stole the show.

The opponent will want to make the catch 
for their final attack. In that case, 
wouldn't they try to overpower them with a 
heavy, spinning pitch?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, bear witness! Behold a single strike 
capable of piercing any impregnable 
defense—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Projectiles away! Batter down the gates!

Unleashed with a furious spin, the ball 
changed trajectory mid-air, ricocheted off 
a pillar――

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Owwie!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: What kind of crash was thaaat?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: M-My glorious moment... Alas, the regret~!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, crap! So that was the blunder path, 
huh!

text_block_list.name: Teammate Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Ahaha! Messing up right here is 
just such a classic No Reason moment, I 
love it~!
